name: Update gift card balance correctly after voiding a gift card payment and paying with cash

steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "6566"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('5', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Willow" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the "Manicure" service
When I add the "Manicure" service to my cart
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I click on the total price of "Manicure"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
And I click on the "Pay" button
And I select the "Gift" payment type
And I fill the last 4 digits of card number "1003"
And I click on the "OK" button
Then I should see the payment Gift history "Gift (1003) $17.50" visible

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__payment--list li').filter({ has: locator('span.name').filter({ hasText: 'Gift (1003)' }) }).filter({ has: locator('span.amt').filter({ hasText: '$17.50' }) })

Expect "toContainText" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__payment--list li').filter({ has: locator('span.name').filter({ hasText: 'Gift (1003)' }) }).filter({ has: locator('span.amt').filter({ hasText: '$17.50' }) }).locator('span.name')

Expect "toContainText" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__payment--list li').filter({ has: locator('span.name').filter({ hasText: 'Gift (1003)' }) }).filter({ has: locator('span.amt').filter({ hasText: '$17.50' }) }).locator('span.amt')
When I click on the "Close Ticket" button
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Close Ticket', exact: true })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Close Ticket', exact: true })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
Then I should see the first ticket of payment "$17.50"
When I reopen ticket with payment amount "$17.50"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$17.50' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$17.50' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$17.50' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the user info "Willow" in the ticket
When I click on the "Pay" button
Then I should see the payment history "Gift (1003)$17.50 " visible
When I select the payment history "Gift (1003)$17.50 "
And I click on the "VOID" button
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Gift  - $17.50"
When I click on the "Remove" button
And I click on the "Cancel" button
And I click on the total price of "Manicure"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
And I click on the "Pay" button
And I select the "Cash" payment type
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Close Ticket"
When I click on the "OK" button in the popup dialog
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
Given I am on the GIFT_CARD_BALANCE page
Then I should see the first type "ActivateNew" in the gift card detail list
And I should see the first amount "$100.00" in the gift card detail list
